title: Dread & Wonder — IMAX Title Slate
description: A cinematic title card anchored by a towering high-contrast serif logotype and a tracked small-caps tagline, set against a desaturated atmospheric backdrop kissed by a single ember-orange light source — closer to a Villeneuve one-sheet than any conventional slide template.
philosophy: This template exists for the rare moment when a presentation must feel like a theatrical event rather than a document with transitions. It borrows the visual grammar of IMAX campaign keys — near-monochromatic atmosphere, a single burning accent color, and typography scaled to monument proportions — and flatly refuses bullets, decorative icons, gradient overlays, and busy layouts. The speaker is the director; the slide is the poster. Every element earns its pixel or gets cut in the grade.
goodFor: Film, documentary, or event premiere announcement slides
Single-statement brand or product launch hero cards
3-line logline or tagline reveals in pitch screenings
Keynote openers where the speaker walks onto a darkened stage
avoidFor: Chart-heavy quarterly business reviews requiring readable data
Academic presentations with dense citation blocks
Collaborative decks where stakeholders expect editable bullet layouts
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like a theatrical one-sheet — monumental, still, and faintly unsettling. A single off-axis light source bleeds warmth into an otherwise desaturated atmosphere, as if dawn or disaster approaches from just outside the frame. The composition breathes through vast negative space above and around the logotype, treating silence as a design element. Avoid symmetrical arrangements, decorative flourishes, and anything that competes with the singular gravitational pull of the title.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed backdrop with zero outer margin — atmosphere bleeds to every edge of the canvas. A 12-column grid underlies the composition; the primary logotype spans columns 2–11, anchored at roughly 55% from the top so the upper field exhales with cinematic weight. The tracked small-caps tagline sits two clear line-heights beneath the logotype, centered, with no surrounding rule lines or decorative dividers. Page number and all chrome are fully suppressed; a single faint production or deck credit may appear at minimum scale in the bottom-right corner only.

examples.promptCore: A cinematic chapter card: atmospheric depth commands the upper field while a single stark statement anchors the lower zone with monumental weight, creating deliberate tension between open negative space and typographic gravity. The composition is asymmetrically bottom-heavy — slow, pressurized, and theatrical rather than informational. One ember-toned light source grazes the scene from a single edge, implying warmth and direction without competing with the text block. Avoid decorative flourishes, icon clusters, or any element that breaks the mood of a held, darkened stage.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed canvas with an approximately 8% outer margin on all sides; a 12-column grid places the primary text block in columns 2–10, anchored firmly in the lower third of the frame. The dominant statement scales to near-monumental proportion, with a tracked small-caps attribution or secondary line sitting below it, separated by a single hairline rule. The upper two-thirds of the frame are deliberately left open to sustain the atmospheric depth of the backdrop. Slide folio appears at bottom-right at minimal scale; no header band, no decorative border, no icon gutter.
